extracted.name: Homemade White Hot Chocolate
extracted.description: This quick and easy homemade white hot chocolate recipe uses just 4 ingredients to make a warm, comforting drink that's perfect for winter nights.
instruction_lines: Combine white chocolate chips and half-and-half in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Stir continuously until chocolate has completely melted, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in milk and vanilla extract until heated through, 3 to 4 minutes more.
